# Third-party browser libraries

These files are served locally with the site; there are no CDN requests at runtime.

- SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 — Apache-2.0 — https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- html2canvas 1.4.1 — MIT — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/dist/html2canvas.min.js
- JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js

Copyright and license notices are retained in the distributed files. Additional license texts accompany these libraries in this folder.
